title: HubHum — A Git Hub for Humans: Curated Directory of Free & Open-Source Software Without Tech Jargon
description: A curated static directory, REST JSON catalog, OpenAPI 3.0 endpoint, and multi-language plain-English knowledge base explaining 1,000+ free and open-source desktop, self-hosted, and CLI applications across 70 Topic Cluster guides and 6 curated starter bundles with direct upstream download links.
